commit.author: Konstantinos Vantas <kon.vantas@gmail.com>
commit.message:
- Correct timestamp interpretation using source UTC-offset metadata
- Validate arguments and downloaded payloads while preserving error details
- Fix default subdomains and accept valid zero-valued lookup IDs
- Improve coordinate parsing and document station coordinates as WGS84
- Correct water-division translations and preserve scientific unit symbols
- Repair bundled variable labels and document upstream date-quality issues
- Replace ineffective HTTP mocks with deterministic offline tests
- Modernize data-generation scripts and use complete station keys
- Update broken links, dependency metadata, CI, and release documentation
- Regenerate README and package documentation

Validation: all tests and devtools::check() pass; all R Markdown
documents compile successfully.
